    "languages": ["en", "fa"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.6
  },
  {
    "operation": "cross_language_homophone",
    "chain": "red (en) ≈ rouge (fr) ≈ rojo (es); rocks ≈ roches (fr) ≈ rocas (es)",
    "reading": "Rouge-roches: red rocks as the alchemical rubedo stage, the reddening of the stone",
    "languages": ["en", "fr", "es"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.7
  },
  {
    "operation": "anagram",
    "chain": "red rocks → cored + rks; cored = hollowed out, rks = archaic rune name for 'r'",
    "reading": "Cored runes: the hollowed letters of the alphabet, the empty vessel of speech",
    "languages": ["en", "grc"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.5
  },
  {
    "operation": "notariqon",
    "chain": "R + R = Red Rocks; R = rex (king), R = rota (wheel) in Latin",

    "languages": ["la"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.6
  },
  {
    "operation": "letter_symbol",
    "chain": "R = head (in Hebrew resh, ר); R = sun in alchemy; rocks = petra (stone)",
    "reading": "The sun-headed stone: the philosopher's stone crowned with solar light, the lapis",
    "languages": ["he", "la"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.7
  },
  {
    "operation": "numerical",
    "chain": "red = r(18)+e(5)+d(4)=27; rocks = r(18)+o(15)+c(3)+k(11)+s(19)=66; total=93",
    "reading": "93 is the Thelemic number of will and love; red rocks as the willed stone of desire",
    "languages": ["en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.4
  },
  {
    "operation": "etymology",
    "chain": "red (PIE *reudh-) = red; rocks (PIE *k̑er-?) = hard, but rocca is obscure",
    "reading": "The ruddy hardness: the primeval red earth, the first stone of creation",
    "languages": ["en", "ine"],
    "source": "Pokorny's Indogermanisches Etymologisches Wörterbuch",
    "confidence": 0.5
  }
]
